findings.title: Distinct Pulse edges coalesce before the next fixed frame
findings.detail: InputRouter stored pending Pulse as a boolean. Two valid non-repeat edges could both report pulseEdge true before consumeFrame, but only one simulation Pulse and no second cooldown feedback were consumed.
